description: This file is a Perl test script that tests the Coocook::Model::Ingredients module, including methods like as_arrayref, all_articles, and all_units, using the Test2 testing framework.

methods.name: as_arrayref
methods.description: Returns an array reference of ingredient items, optionally scaled by servings, or dies on unsupported arguments.

methods.name: all_articles
methods.description: Returns an array reference of article objects associated with the ingredients.

methods.name: all_units
methods.description: Returns an array reference of unit objects used in the ingredients.
